start_grasp_server: start a GraspServer RPC server that listens for grasp and collision requests on a0 topics
get_grasps_from_pcd: use GraspClient to send a point cloud and receive computed grasp groups from the server
check_collision_grasps: use GraspClient to check which grasps collide with a scene point cloud and filter them
visualize_grasp_on_scene: use GraspClient to visualize top N grasps on a scene point cloud and save rendered images
get_obj_grasps_with_filter: use GraspClient to get collision-filtered grasps for each object point cloud in a scene
